blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Autonomous video editing from open-world resources remains a challenging problem in multimedia content creation. Retrieval-based methods are constrained by fixed source material and lack creative flexibility, while generative models struggle with long-horizon coherence and often diverge from user intent. Both paradigms fail to replicate the structured, multi-stage reasoning that underlies professional post-production. To address these limitations, we present Auto-Director, a tool-augmented multi-agent framework that mirrors professional editorial workflows: a Planning Agent decomposes abstract topics into fact-grounded scripts via retrieval-augmented planning; a Material Agent indexes open-world footage through shot segmentation and visual tagging; an Editor Agent assembles semantically aligned clips with MLLM-driven spatial adaptation; and a Critic Agent governs an iterative Reflect-and-Revise loop that checks scene-level alignment and pacing. To rigorously evaluate this new paradigm, we introduce VEdit-Bench, a benchmark of 100 expert-curated topics with human-annotated Golden Scripts and a five-dimensional metric suite covering Narrative Logic, Factual Accuracy, Semantic Alignment, Compositional Quality, and Stylistic Cohesion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Auto-Director significantly outperforms baseline methods in both automated metrics and human evaluation, effectively bridging the gap between amateurs and professional-grade video production.
blocks.zh: 从开放世界资源进行自主视频编辑仍然是多媒体内容创作中的一个挑战性问题. 基于检索的方法受到固定源材料的限制,缺乏创造性的灵活性,而基因模型则与长距离的连贯性发生斗争,并经常偏离用户意图. 这两种模式都未能复制构成专业生产后基础的结构化、多阶段的推理。 为了克服这些局限性,我们介绍Auto-Director,这是一个工具强化的多代理框架,反映了专业编辑工作流程:一个规划代理通过检索-Augleed 规划将抽象主题分解为事实脚本;一个材料代理通过镜头分割和视觉标记来索引开放世界的镜头;一个编辑代理集合了与MLLLM驱动的空间适应性一致的剪辑;以及一个批评代理管理一个反复反射和校正循环,以检查场面的调整和节奏。 为了严格评价这个新模式,我们引入了Vedit-Bench,这是100个专家精准专题的基准,带有人文说明的金字本和一个五维度的计量套件,涵盖叙述逻辑、事实准确性、语义校正、组成质量和结构统一。 广泛的实验表明,自动导演在自动度量衡和人的评价方面都大大超过基准方法,有效地缩小了业余人员与专业级视频制作之间的差距。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video has become a dominant medium for information dissemination and storytelling, yet professional
production remains labor-intensive, demanding expertise in scriptwriting, material sourcing, and aesthetic
editing [ 35 ] , which places narrative-driven production out of reach for most amateurs.

生产仍然是劳动密集型的,在脚本编写、材料来源和美学方面要求很高的专门知识

blocks.en:
Recent advances in AI have fostered two primary directions for automated video creation, and both face
limitations for open-world, long-form storytelling (see Fig. 1 ). Retrieval-based methods
compose highlights from a fixed source corpus, as in trailer generation [ 1 ] ; grounded in
real footage, they are constrained by their source material and cannot easily bridge the semantic gap between
nuanced script requirements and coarse dataset metadata. Generation-based methods instead synthesize clips
directly from text [ 2 , 33 ] ; although increasingly capable on visual quality, cinematic
multi-shot generation still treats structural control and cross-shot consistency as open
challenges [ 36 , 31 ] , and such methods remain vulnerable to long-horizon inconsistency, factual
hallucination, and weak controllability over many scenes. A third, more recent line applies agentic decomposition directly to video
editing [ 15 , 16 , 39 ] .
These systems emphasize different parts of the workflow; none combines externally grounded factual planning,
structured shot-level indexing, and an iterative quality-control loop in one pipeline.

blocks.en:
To address these limitations, we present Auto-Director, an agentic framework for open-world autonomous video editing that emulates the
professional post-production workflow through four specialized agents. In contrast to human-in-the-loop
language-assisted editors such as LAVE [ 27 ] , our goal is full pipeline autonomy. A Planning
Agent translates abstract topics into fact-grounded scripts via Retrieval-Augmented Planning, decoupling
factual accuracy from language fluency. A Material Agent converts open-world footage into structured,
searchable assets through shot boundary detection and explicit visual tagging, reducing cross-modal retrieval
to text-to-text matching. An Editor Agent performs two-stage semantic matching and MLLM-driven spatial
adaptation to synthesize a coherent draft. Finally, a Critic Agent then governs a Reflect-and-Revise loop, dispatching
structured feedback upstream to check alignment and pacing.

To evaluate this setting, we introduce VEdit-Bench, a benchmark of 100 expert-curated topics paired with
human-annotated Golden Scripts and fragmented material repositories that require open-world retrieval, with a
five-dimensional metric suite. Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose Auto-Director, a fully automated multi-agent framework orchestrating four specialized agents
to produce narrative videos from open-world resources, with an iterative Reflect-and-Revise mechanism that
self-corrects across retrieval, composition, and pacing. • We construct VEdit-Bench, a benchmark of 100 expert-curated topics with human-annotated Golden Scripts
and fragmented material repositories, paired with a five-dimensional metric suite including Factual Accuracy,
a dimension prior video generation benchmarks do not explicitly target. • Extensive experiments demonstrate that Auto-Director significantly outperforms leading baselines across all five metrics, effectively bridging the gap between amateur creators and professional-grade video production.

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Narrative Video Creation
blocks.zh: 2.1 叙述录像制作

blocks.en:
Progress on narrative video creation spans controllable generation and automated editing. Story visualization exposed the need for global narrative consistency beyond isolated frame synthesis, and
recent methods target explicitly cinematic multi-shot generation: STAGE [ 36 , 30 ] introduces
storyboard-anchored generation with cross-shot memory, and related work studies long-form storytelling
through adaptive memory and staged generation. These remain fully generative and therefore cannot ground a
scene in verifiable real-world evidence.

最近的方法明确针对电影的多镜头制作:STAGE [36, 30]介绍

automation, but either remain fully generative, assume closed-world assets, or keep the human editor in the
loop at execution time.

planning, rendering, and self-critique roles. World-To-Image [ 24 , 32 , 34 ] , for example, grounds

for video editing, where planning, material organization, editing, and refinement need to be coordinated.

blocks.en: 3.2 Material Agent
blocks.zh: 3.2 材料剂

blocks.en:
The Material Agent bridges abstract script requirements and raw open-world footage. Its design addresses two
limitations of existing retrieval paradigms: dual-encoder VLMs such as CLIP [ 19 , 47 , 48 , 50 ] may lack
the world knowledge needed for knowledge-intensive concepts such as historical events or named entities [ 26 , 41 , 42 , 46 ] , while MLLMs often localize event boundaries imprecisely [ 10 ] . We therefore convert footage into a structured, text-indexed asset library 𝒟 \mathcal{D} before semantic matching.

blocks.en: 4 VEdit-Bench
blocks.zh: 4个Vedit-Bench

blocks.en: In this section, we introduce VEdit-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate the full lifecycle of autonomous video editing. It combines expert-curated topics, human-annotated Golden Scripts, and fragmented material repositories to evaluate systems under realistic long-form editing scenarios.
blocks.zh: 在这一节中,我们引入了Vedit-Bench,这个基准旨在评价自主视频编辑的整个生命周期. 它将专家精准的题目、人文说明的金文稿和零散的材料库结合起来,在现实的长式编辑方案下评价系统。

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准建设

blocks.en:
We manually curated 100 diverse topics from trending educational and documentary categories on global video
platforms and filtered them through a panel of five human experts. The topics follow a three-tiered difficulty
taxonomy and are distributed as 40 Easy / 40 Medium / 20 Hard:
(1) Entity-Centric , centered on concrete visual entities (e.g., “The Life Cycle of a Monarch
Butterfly”);
(2) Abstract Concept , requiring cross-domain reasoning to translate non-visual ideas into coherent
imagery (e.g., “The Impact of AI on Modern Society”); and
(3) Complex Narrative , requiring strict temporal logic and identification of specific historical or
technical entities (e.g., “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Empire”).
blocks.zh:
我们手动整理了100个不同主题,
并通过一个由5名人类专家组成的小组过滤。 题目有三层难度
分类学和分布为40易/40中/20难:
(1) 实体-中心,以具体视觉实体为中心(例如,“君主的生命周期”
蝴蝶”);
(2)摘要概念,要求跨领域推理将非视觉思想转化为连贯的概念.
图像(例如“大赦国际对现代社会的影响”);
(3) 复杂的叙述,要求严格的时间逻辑和识别具体的历史或历史
技术实体(例如“罗马帝国的兴衰”)

blocks.en: For each of the 100 topics, professional scriptwriters composed a Golden Script ( S g ​ o ​ l ​ d S_{gold} ) containing precise narration, fact-anchored milestones, and required visual evidence descriptions. Each script was validated by three additional expert annotators (Fleiss’ κ = 0.74 \kappa=0.74 ), and serves as the ground-truth reference for video evaluation.
blocks.zh: 专业编剧为100个专题中的每一个专题,都组成了金色脚本(Sgo o l d S_{gold}),包含精确的叙述,事实所记的里程碑,并需要视觉证据描述. 每个脚本都经过另外三个专家注释员的验证(Fleiss ' ob = 0.74\kappa= 0.74),并作为视频评价的地面参考.

blocks.en:
For each topic, we provide local video assets that deliberately cover only a partial subset of the required
visual milestones, averaging 58% coverage of those defined in S g ​ o ​ l ​ d S_{gold} . This fragmented setting reflects
practical editing scenarios in which the available footage may not fully satisfy the narrative requirements,
requiring the system to retrieve missing evidence from external sources.

视觉里程碑,平均覆盖58%,在Sg o l d S_{gold}中定义的. 这种支离破碎的设定反映了
实际编辑情景,即现有录像可能不能完全满足叙述要求,
要求系统从外部来源获取缺失的证据。

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价计量

blocks.en:
We propose a five-dimensional metric suite. All metrics are evaluated by prompting an
MLLM [ 5 ] . The judge uses sampled keyframes with task-specific references, including S g ​ o ​ l ​ d S_{gold} for Factual Accuracy
and generated narration for Semantic Alignment. All systems are evaluated with the same protocol, and the agreement between MLLM and human
judgments is further validated in Sect. 5.5 .

我们提出一个五维度量度套件。 所有衡量标准都通过提示来评估。
MLLM [5] (英语). 法官使用带有特定任务参考的抽样关键框架,包括Sg o l d S_{gold}用于事实准确性
并生成语义对齐的叙述。 所有系统都通过同样的协议以及MLLM与人类
第5.5节进一步确认了判决。

blocks.en:
The MLLM processes sampled keyframes together with the generated script and evaluates narrative flow along
three dimensions: causal progression , whether each scene follows logically from the previous one; thematic consistency , whether the overall topic remains focused without unnecessary digression; and structural coherence , whether the narrative forms a clear introduction, development, and conclusion.
Narrative Logic therefore captures high-level failures such as abrupt logical transitions, unresolved
narrative threads, and contradictions between adjacent scenes.
blocks.zh:
MLLM 进程对密钥框架和生成的脚本进行了抽样,并评价了叙事流程
三个层面:因果进展,每个场景是否与前一个场景逻辑一致;专题一致性,总体专题是否仍然有重点,而不无必要分裂;结构一致性,说明是否构成明确的导言、发展和结论。
因此,叙述逻辑记录了高层次的失败,如突然的逻辑转换,尚未解决
叙事线条,以及相邻场景之间的矛盾.

blocks.en:
The MLLM cross-references sampled keyframes against the fact-anchored milestones and required visual evidence
in S g ​ o ​ l ​ d S_{gold} , verifying whether the depicted entities, objects, structures, and events are objectively
correct regardless of what the model-generated narration states. This metric targets visual factual errors
such as incorrect historical figures, species, artifacts, or visually similar but factually distinct
landmarks. It therefore evaluates correctness against the Golden Script rather than consistency with the
system’s own narration.

For each scene s i s_{i} , a MLLM evaluates sampled keyframes alongside
the model-generated narration T i T_{i} , assessing whether the described entities, actions, and events are physically manifested in the video at the correct temporal position. Unlike Factual Accuracy, which measures correctness against the ground-truth S g ​ o ​ l ​ d S_{gold} , Semantic Alignment measures internal consistency between the model’s own narration and the retrieved footage, and can thus diverge from Factual Accuracy: a scene may achieve high SA when the footage
faithfully supports an incorrect narration, or low SA when correct footage is paired with a misaligned description. The final SA score is averaged across all N N scenes.

The MLLM scores each clip along three aspects: subject preservation , whether the primary subject
described in T i T_{i} remains correctly framed within the target aspect ratio; spatial balance , whether
the composition avoids perceptual imbalance or excessive dead space; and cropping artifact avoidance ,
whether re-framing unintentionally removes salient visual regions. Compositional Quality therefore reflects
the within-shot layout quality produced by the spatial adaptation stage, with scores averaged over all N N scenes.

The MLLM assesses the global visual consistency of the assembled video by examining whether the dominant
visual style, such as cinematic, archival, or animated footage, remains coherent across clips. Unlike

metric that penalizes abrupt stylistic discontinuities caused by heterogeneous source footage, including
changes in color grading, film grain, and overall production quality.

All agents use Gemini 3.1 Pro as the backbone model. Planning-stage retrieval uses the Google Search and
Wikipedia APIs. Scripts follow a fixed JSON schema with a predefined scene template, with at most N = 10 N=10 scenes per video. Shot boundary detection uses PySceneDetect, and each shot is tagged with a unique Shot ID
and timestamp superimposed on keyframes sampled at 1 FPS.

Providing the same footage repository to strong MLLMs improves Factual Accuracy and Narrative Logic, with
GPT-5.4 performing best among them. However, they remain weaker on Semantic Alignment and Compositional

The Material Agent instead converts footage into a compact text-indexed library 𝒟 \mathcal{D} .

blocks.en: VideoAgent performs best among the agentic baselines, owing to its intent decomposition and graph-based orchestration, yet still trails Auto-Director on all dimensions; MoneyPrinterTurbo and AutoClip, relying on keyword-based retrieval and single-source transcript analysis, show larger gaps in Factual Accuracy and Semantic Alignment. A key difference is the Critic’s Reflect-and-Revise loop, absent in all three: instead of a one-shot output, the Critic dispatches scene-level feedback upstream, enabling targeted correction without re-running the pipeline.
blocks.zh: VideoAgent在代理基线中表现最好,因为它的意向分解和基于图表的管弦乐,然而仍然追踪到所有维度的自动总监; MoneyPrinterTurbo和AutoClip依靠基于关键词的检索和单源的语录分析,显示在Factal Access和Semantic Accord中差距较大. 一个关键的区别是批评者的反射和评论循环,这在三个方面都不存在:批评者发送的场景级反馈不是一弹即发,而是上游的反馈,能够进行有针对性的纠正而不重新运行管道。

blocks.en: Professional editors score highest on every dimension, reflecting fine-grained aesthetic judgment that is hard to automate. The gap is smallest on Semantic Alignment and largest on Compositional Quality, so sub-frame aesthetic refinement remains the clearest direction for future work; we claim no parity with human editors.
blocks.zh: 专业编辑在每个维度上得分最高,反映了难以自动化的精细审美判断. 这个差距在语义协调上最小,在构成质量上最大,因此子框架美学的完善仍然是未来工作最清楚的方向;我们声称与人类编辑没有平等.
